caption_L1: Here a is a line diagram named Rate of deaths due to fire , flames , or smoke , in the United States from 1915 to 2018 (per 100,000 population). The y-axis measures Deaths per 100,000 population while the x-axis measures Year.
caption_L2L3: In 1915 8.25 deaths of every 100,000 were due to fire, flames or smoke in the US. This trend declined to one in 2018. However, exception occurred in 1945 and 1960 where deaths were 6 and 4.25 respectfully.
